# Flow Messaging

> One API for AI agents to talk with people on WhatsApp, Telegram and iMessage. Flow hosts the senders (Telegram bots, WhatsApp numbers, iMessage lines), delivers inbound messages as typed events (webhooks, a WebSocket stream, or polling) and sends typed content through one gate that applies each channel's rules. HTTP API at https://api.flow.engineer; TypeScript SDK `@flow-engineer/messaging`; MCP server at https://api.flow.engineer/mcp.

No key yet? Check `FLOW_MESSAGING_KEY` first; if it is unset, get a test key with no account in one call, and save `key` as `FLOW_MESSAGING_KEY` and `claim_token` as `FLOW_CLAIM_TOKEN` (both shown once):

```sh
curl -X POST https://api.flow.engineer/v1/sandbox/keys   # or: npx @flow-engineer/messaging init (writes both to .env)
```

- The answer also holds the sandbox senders: a person joins by opening `senders[].address.link` (Telegram: tap Start) or sending its `join_code`. Rate limited per address (`429 rate_limited`, `retry_after`); never call it when you already have a key.
- Sandbox allowance. No account: 1 contact, 50 messages in total, Telegram sandbox (WhatsApp when its sandbox opens), key expires after 7 days. Signed in: 3 contacts x 100 messages per person (shared by all their apps), no expiry. iMessage is in neither. Only messages your agent sends count. `GET /v1/app` returns `allowance`.
- Sign in to keep the app (GitHub or Google, device flow): `npx @flow-engineer/messaging login`. Agents that cannot wait: `login --no-wait` prints the link and code and exits; run `login` again after the person approves. By HTTP: `POST /v1/device/authorizations` with `{"claim_token": "fct_..."}`, show `verification_uri_complete` and `user_code` (the person types the code), poll `POST /v1/device/token` with `{"device_code": "fdc_..."}` every `interval` seconds until `approved` (`key`: replace `FLOW_MESSAGING_KEY`; the old key stops working), `denied` or `expired`. A claim through `claim_url` in a browser gives no new key and keeps the old one working.
- Errors: `403 permission` with `channel_code` `sandbox_allowance_used`, `sandbox_contact_limit`, `sandbox_channel_not_included` or `sign_in_required`; `401 authentication` with `sandbox_key_expired`. Fix: sign in, or get a new key.
- Dashboard: https://api.flow.engineer/admin. Full page: https://docs.flow.engineer/get-a-key

Quickstart (TypeScript, Node 18+/Bun/Deno/edge):

```ts
import { FlowMessaging, contentText } from "@flow-engineer/messaging";
const flow = new FlowMessaging(); // FLOW_MESSAGING_KEY
for await (const event of flow.events.stream({ types: ["message.received"] })) {
  await event.conversation.reply(llmStream(contentText(event.data.message.content)));
}
```

- Keys: `fk_test_...` (shared sandbox only; a person joins by opening the sandbox link and tapping Start, or by sending the join code, e.g. `join wild-otter-04508705`) and `fk_live_...`. Signed in, you make live keys in the dashboard and connect your own Telegram bot; iMessage and WhatsApp senders are arranged with the Flow team. `npx @flow-engineer/messaging init` (or `init --key fk_test_...` for a key you have) writes `FLOW_MESSAGING_KEY` to `.env`, prints the join code, and asks before installing agent files and the MCP server `flow` (`--yes` skips the question). SDK without a key: `flow.sandbox.createKey()`, `flow.device.signIn({ claimToken, prompt })`.
- Handler type: `FlowEvent` (or `FlowEventOf<"message.received">`) is what the stream and webhook handlers give you; its `conversation` has `reply`, `send`, `typing`, `markRead`, `react`. `Event` is the plain API JSON (`flow.events.list()`).
- Sends: `flow.messages.send(convId, { content, reply_to: "msg_..." })` for an inline reply (the message's `reply_to` echoes it). Files: `const file = await flow.files.upload({ file: bytes, filename })` (Blob, Uint8Array/Buffer or ArrayBuffer), then send `{ type: "media", kind: "document", file_id: file.id }`.
- `event.conversation.reply(x)` accepts a string, content, a list of content, or a stream from OpenAI, Anthropic, Vercel AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, LangChain, Mastra or any AsyncIterable<string>; it keeps typing on and sends chat bubbles split at paragraph and sentence ends.
- Webhooks: `Flow-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "t.{t}.{raw body}">`, 5-minute window; SDK: `await flow.webhooks.constructEvent(rawBody, signature, secret)` or `flow.webhooks.handler({ secret, onEvent })`. Answer `200 {"reply": <content>}` (or a list of up to 10, with optional `fallback`) to reply at once; any other answer (such as plain `OK`) sends nothing; a JSON object with an invalid `reply` sends nothing and is recorded on the delivery as `invalid_request`. Rotate the secret with `flow.webhookEndpoints.rotateSecret(id, { overlap_seconds })`; during the overlap `Flow-Signature` carries one `v1` per secret.
- Rules: reply into a conversation (no channel choice per message); contacts may have no phone number; WhatsApp needs a template after 24 h (`outside_window`); content a channel cannot show needs `fallback: "auto"` (`unsupported_content`); errors are a closed list of `error.type`, each with a `hint` and a `doc_url` (`https://api.flow.engineer/docs/errors/<type>`); every POST takes `Idempotency-Key`; `Flow-Version: 2026-11-01`.

## Docs

- [TypeScript SDK README](https://github.com/flow-engineer/sdk/blob/main/typescript/README.md): client, events, webhooks, reply and bubbles, errors, CLI, agent files
- [OpenAPI spec](https://github.com/flow-engineer/sdk/blob/main/openapi/openapi.yaml): every endpoint, content type, event type and error type
- [Claude Code skill](https://github.com/flow-engineer/sdk/blob/main/plugin/skills/flow-messaging/SKILL.md): the short guide coding agents load
- [API and content reference](https://github.com/flow-engineer/sdk/blob/main/plugin/skills/flow-messaging/reference/api.md)
- [Frameworks](https://github.com/flow-engineer/sdk/blob/main/plugin/skills/flow-messaging/reference/frameworks.md): OpenAI, Anthropic, Vercel AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Mastra, LangChain, Eve
- [CLI and MCP](https://github.com/flow-engineer/sdk/blob/main/plugin/skills/flow-messaging/reference/cli-mcp.md)
- [Documentation site](https://docs.flow.engineer)
